main_screen.title: Main page
main_screen.info_message:
From the main menu, you select the part of the program you want to use:
Data management (CRUD).
File management.
Email management.
Administration (which will be locked for non-administrators).

In addition, there is a logout button to stop using your account, allowing you to enter another one by redirecting to the login page.

administration.info_message:
On the administrator's main screen, the following buttons are displayed:
Manage User, to create users.
Manage Roles, to view existing roles, assign permissions to them, and add new roles.
Assign Roles, to assign roles to multiple users in the database.
Logs, to view the system logs (activities realized in the platform).
Manage WhiteList, to add and eliminate users from the whitelist.

register_users.title: Register user
register_users.info_message:
The user is asked to enter a name, an email address, an email password, and a password (which must be entered again for confirmation to avoid errors).
Click 'Delete' for more information about deleting an user

roles.manage_info: In the table, the different roles can be seen. These roles are customized according to the company's needs, along with their corresponding permissions. Permissions can be assigned or removed depending on the selected checkboxes. To create a new role, the "Add Role" button must be clicked, which opens a window to enter its name and description.
roles.assign_info:
Roles can be assigned or removed manually in the administrator window. This section displays a table with the user and their email address, as well as the roles they have (or an indication that they have no roles).
To assign a new role, select the role from the combo box at the bottom, select the user(s) you want in the table, and click the "Assign" button. To remove a role, repeat the same process but click the "Remove" button.
roles.title: Role Management

data_management.info_message: Here, the database information is managed. The table displays the data from the different tables. To create a new field, the table is selected and the "New" button is clicked. When clicking on a record, a menu appears where a new field can be created, updated, or deleted. To update or create a field, a window with a form appears; for completely new data, a text box is provided for typing, and for fields coming from other tables, a dropdown menu is used.
data_management.species_info: This button opens the table with the species data, with the following fields: id and name
data_management.enclosure_info: This button opens the table with the enclosure data, with the following fields: id, name, adress, origin amount and destination amount
data_management.keeper_info: This button opens the current table
data_management.animals_info: This button opens the table with the animals data, with the following fields: id, name, type(male or female), specie and keeper
data_management.transfers_info: This button opens the table with the transfers data, with the following fields: id, description, origin enclosure and destination enclosure
data_management.species_enclosures_info: This button opens the table with the species and enclosures data, with the following fields: id from the species and id from the enclosure (to control what species are in determined enclosures)

file_manager.info_message: In this section, the following actions can be performed (depending on the permissions granted) on the files using the buttons located on the right, push them for more information
file_manager.upload_info: Upload: Allows uploading files to the server.
file_manager.download_info: Download: Allows downloading files from the server.
file_manager.delete_info: Delete: Allows deleting files from the server.
file_manager.new_folder_info: New Folder: Allows creating folders on the server.
file_manager.delete_folder_info: Delete Folder: Allows deleting folders from the server.
file_manager.file_info: The files on the server can be viewed. The central window is navigable: to go forward, click on the desired folder on the screen, and to go back, click the "Back" button.
file_manager.rename_info: Rename: Allows the change of files and folder's name on the server."

email.inbox_info: When accessing the email section, the inbox is displayed, showing the subject, the sender, and the date. By double-clicking on one of the rows in the table, the detailed information of the selected email is opened. This table is automatically refreshed after a period of time, or by clicking the "Refresh" button. While the refresh is in progress, the "Refresh" button is disabled. By clicking the "Compose" button, you can access the email sending screen (click for more details).
email.send_info:
When sending emails, you must enter the recipient's email address, the subject, and the message to be sent. The recipient must be on the whitelist; otherwise, the email cannot be sent. You can attach as many files as you want using the "Attach" button; files are added by browsing through a file explorer and are sent using the "Send" button.
Push 'Send' to continue

whitelist.info_message: Users are added to the email whitelist through the administration panel by the administrator. Push the buttons for more information.
whitelist.add_info: A new user can be created using a form, with email and name fields
whitelist.remove_info: To remove users from the WhiteList, select one or more and click the 'Remove' button.
whitelist.title: Whitelist Management

delete_user.info_message: To delete a user, select a user from the table and click 'Delete' to remove them from the database and the FTP server.
delete_user.title: Delete User

logs.info_message:
The log system is designed to provide a complete record of activities performed on the platform. It allows administrators to monitor system behavior, audit access, and detect potential operational errors.
The recorded activities show the different operations performed (for example, a login), the email of the user who performed them, the date, and the result (whether it was successful or an error).
At the top of the screen, you can filter logs by different fields (operation, user, date, or result).
In the lower-left corner of the log window, there is an option to export the logs as a CSV file.
logs.title: System Logs
